dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the 2D lateral profile from the widest mid-body point toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to light grey; high-value median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct, elongated white linear marks (scars/rake marks) visible on the dorsal surface, including a prominent branched mark on the right lateral side and several fine longitudinal streaks near the midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple high-contrast white linear scars across the mid-to-posterior dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a high-contrast, dark circular focal point at the anterior apex of the visible body mass.
